svg.title: Agent-ready SDLC: lifecycle and gates
svg.desc: Lifecycle: Plan (intent.md, owner approves) → Design (optional, spec.md, owner signs off; a simple fix skips design) → Build (plan.md + code, engineer / tech lead) → Test (evals/, code owner reviews) → Deploy (review-findings.md, code owner) → Production gate: the agent stops here, release manager authorizes → Maintain (new intent.md, service owner triages) → loop back to Plan. Request changes keeps the task in the same stage. Each stage reads the previous stage's last commit; every approval is recorded in the approvals log.
svg.text: Every stage commits an artifact and stops at a named human gate.

text.tspan: Each stage reads the previous stage's last commit
· nothing runs from memory or from an uncommitted draft

svg.text: → back to the same stage (any gate)
peer sessions never count · no release manager configured → refused (fail closed)
Every human approval is recorded → approvals log
## Approvals section · commit trailer · board approvals/ (append-only)
loop back to Plan: the new intent.md starts the next cycle
